# Slab

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 5 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Knowledge-base marketing: plum hero (#42022e), coral Get Started (#ff4143), Sentinel headlines, Whitney body, and a signed-out subdomain login card.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and the signed-out login page. Register asks for email, full name and password, so it was not submitted. Google signup was not clicked. No company SSO, card, phone or KYC step was entered.. Themes: light.

Slab (slab.com) is knowledge-base and wiki software. This package records the public marketing site and the signed-out login page, measured on 2026-11-19. No account was created. Google signup was not clicked. The register form asks for an email, a full name and a password, so it was not submitted.

Computed styles were read in a T3 preview tab at 1169 by 731 CSS pixels, devicePixelRatio 2. Headless Playwright then saved public marketing screenshots at 1440 by 900 and 390 by 844, after those pages had already loaded without a Cloudflare challenge. Login and register were not opened in that headless session.

## Typography

### Fonts (from README.md)

Whitney is the marketing sans (`whitney, system-ui, helvetica, sans-serif`). Sentinel is the marketing serif (`sentinel, georgia, serif`). Untitled Sans is the login and register face. Roboto is loaded only for the "Sign up with Google" glyph. IBM Plex Mono is declared and unused on these pages. The font files are self-hosted on slab.com and are not in this package. Tokens name the computed families and fall back to system-ui, Helvetica, and Georgia.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The live CSS viewport was 1169, not 1440. The 1440 and 390 screenshots are a later headless pass of the marketing pages, not the viewport the computed styles were read at. Hover, pressed and disabled colours come from stylesheet rules, not from a shown state. The home email field's programmatic focus did not paint the cyan focus ring the stylesheet declares, so that ring is a rule, not a shown state. `core.color.focus` and `light.border.focus` (`#e59700`) are Chromium's default focus ring on a focused link, labelled Observed: the product does not style it, so do not ship it as a brand focus colour. No dark theme was found. `prefers-color-scheme` was dark in the preview tab and the page stayed on the plum and white palette. IBM Plex Mono is declared in an `@font-face` and was not used on the pages opened. Screenshot colours are 24-bit PNGs. Read values from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use plum for the home hero and white for interior pages.** Home nav and hero are `#42022e`. Pricing nav and page are `#ffffff`. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png) and [screenshots/pricing-light-default.png](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png).
- **Use coral for the marketing primary.** Get Started is `#ff4143`, 6px radius, white Whitney at 18px and weight 600. [components/crops/button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png).
- **Use Sentinel for headlines and Whitney for body.** The hero is Sentinel 42px. Body is Whitney 20px / 32px. [tokens.json](tokens.json).
- **Keep the login card separate from marketing chrome.** Login uses Untitled Sans, a 2px radius, and a plum Continue button on a `#fcf9f8` page. [components.md](components.md).
- **Do not invent a signed-in wiki.** Register asks for a password. It was not submitted. The product app was not opened.
